title: I-Kyber 0.28 isiphumile
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
quote: Sikhipha inguqulo yethu 0.28, enezibuyekezo ezintathu ezinkulu: ama-host e-macOS, ukulungiswa kokuchofoza kanye nenjini entsha yokufaka amakhodi.
html:
Isifikile i-Kyber 0.28!

I-Kyber 0.28 isiyatholakala.

I-Mac manje ayisagcini ngokuxhuma komunye umshini: nayo isingasingatha ukuxhumana. Uma uchofoza ngaphandle kwevidiyo, lokho akusathunyelwa emshinini okude. Amafayela amalogi asenendawo entsha, futhi ekugcineni usungakhetha ukuthi abhale imininingwane engakanani. Sekulula nokuthola impendulo yombuzo othi “Ngisebenzisa yiphi inguqulo?” Kukhona nenjini entsha yokuthwebula ongayizama uma uthanda.

Nakhu okugqamile kule nguqulo.

I-Kyber isisakaza isikrini se-macOS (inguqulo yokuhlola yokuqala)

I-Mac ibilokhu ikwazi ukuxhuma emshinini osingatha ukuxhumana kwe-Kyber. Ku-0.28 nayo isingaba yilowo mshini, kodwa okwamanje leli khono elabathuthukisi abanolwazi olunzulu kuphela.

Umsizi wokufaka usakhiwa, ngakho okwamanje uhlelo lufika ngefayela elicindezelwe elijwayelekile le-.zip. Kuzodingeka uluqalise ngokufaka umyalo (bheka imiyalelo ku-GitLab). Alikho iwindi okumele ulishiye livuliwe, futhi akukho okunye okumelwe ukuqalise ngesandla.

I-ScreenCaptureKit yakwa-Apple ithwebula isikrini nomsindo wesistimu kanyekanye, bese i-VideoToolbox isebenzisa izingxenye ze-Mac uqobo ukufaka ividiyo nomsindo ngekhodi. I-Kyber izikhethela kokubili, ngakho akudingeki ushintshe lutho efayeleni lezilungiselelo ukuze i-Mac isingathe ukuxhumana. Ukuze uthwebule umsindo, kudingeka i-macOS 13 Ventura noma inguqulo entsha kunayo. Uhlelo lutholakala kuphela kuma-Mac ane-Apple Silicon.

Uma uluqalisa okokuqala, zimbili izinto okufanele uzinake. I-macOS izocela imvume yokurekhoda isikrini neyokusebenzisa izici zokufinyeleleka. Uma ungaziniki lezi zimvume, ungase ubone isikrini esimnyama, ikhibhodi negundane kungase kungasebenzi, noma kwenzeke kokubili. Uhlelo lusayinwe ngesiginesha yesikhashana esikhundleni sesitifiketi sikamthuthukisi, ngakho i-Gatekeeper izokhipha isexwayiso uma uluqalisa okokuqala.

Kuseyinguqulo yokuqala, ngakho kusekhona okushodayo. Uma i-Mac isingatha ukuxhumana, yamukela kuphela imiyalo yekhibhodi neyegundane. Okwamanje ayizisekeli izilawuli zemidlalo, ukwabelana ngalokho okukopishiwe, noma izimo zesikhombi segundane lomshini okude. Nophawu olubekwa phezu kwevidiyo alukatholakali.

Ukuchofoza kusebenza kuvidiyo kuphela

Uma ividiyo ingaligcwalisi iwindi — ngenxa yokwehluka kwesilinganiso sobubanzi nokuphakama, ngoba iseshini ivulwe ewindini, noma ngoba ushintshe usayizi wewindi lohlelo oluxhumayo — ukuchofoza emaphethelweni amnyama bekusathunyelwa emshinini okude. Ngaleyo ndlela ubungachofoza into obungayihlosile kulowo mshini.

Manje kuthunyelwa kuphela ukuchofoza okwenzeka kuvidiyo uqobo. Uma uqala ukuhudula kuvidiyo, umshini okude usazowuthola umyalo wokudedela inkinobho, ukuze ingasali sengathi isacindezelwe. Isondo legundane lona lisasebenza noma kuphi ewindini.

Ngisebenzisa yiphi inguqulo?

Umbuzo ulula, kodwa impendulo ibinzima ngendlela emangalisayo: ezinguqulweni ezikhishiwe, inkomba yenguqulo yekhodi ibishiywa ingenalutho noma ivele ithi 0.1.0, okungakusizi ngalutho.

Umyalo omusha othi kyclient --version ukuveza ngokunembile ukuthi usebenzisa yiphi inguqulo. Umugqa wayo kulogi yokuqalisa nawo awusenalutho. Ku-Windows, inguqulo ivela phezulu kumenyu yesithonjana esisendaweni yezaziso, ngenhla kokuthi Qalisa kabusha nokuthi Misa.

Imenyu yendawo yezaziso nayo ayisajahi ukuthi “Kuxhunyiwe”. Phambilini ibikusho lokho lapho nje uhlelo oluxhumayo lungena nge-HTTP, bese ihlala kanjalo noma ukusakaza kungaqalanga. Manje ilinda kuqale iseshini ngempela. Isithonjana sendawo yezaziso sesinophawu olusha lwe-Kyber, njengesesinhlelo esixhumayo esivela ebhavini lezinhlelo noma kwelomsebenzi.

Injini entsha yokuthwebula nokufaka ngekhodi ivula indlela yokuthuthukisa

Kuze kube manje, i-Kyber ibisebenzisa i-txproto ukuthwebula nokufaka ngekhodi. I-0.28 ingeza injini yesibili eyakhelwe ngqo phezu kwe-FFmpeg. Zombili zihlanganiswe efayeleni elifanayo lohlelo. Ukuze ukhethe entsha ngesikhathi sokusebenzisa uhlelo, faka backend = "libavconv" ku-kyber_config.toml.

I-txproto isalokhu iyinjini ekhethwa ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi iyona okubuyelwa kuyo. Ku-Windows naku-Linux, injini entsha isivele isekela ukuthwebula isikrini nomsindo, ukufaka uphawu phezu kwevidiyo, ukulawula izinga lokudluliswa kwamabhithi nezinhlaka eziyisihluthulelo, kanye nokusebenzisa i-RTP. Ayitholakali ku-macOS. Yizame ukhumbule ukuthi iseyinguqulo yokuhlola: isizathu sokufaka zombili ukuthi uma entsha iba nenkinga, ushintshe nje isilungiselelo kunokuba uphinde ufake uhlelo.

Izinguquko ezincane ezenza umehluko

Isilungiselelo esithi encoder efayeleni elithi kyber_config.toml asisaphoqelekile. Uma usishiya ngaphandle, i-Kyber izikhethela indlela efanele yokusebenzisa izingxenye zekhompuyutha ukufaka ngekhodi: i-VideoToolbox ku-Mac, i-NVENC kwezinye izinkundla. Phambilini, ukususa umugqa othi `encoder` bekwenza iseva yokuthwebula ingaqali nhlobo. Bekulula ukubhajwa lapho unciphisa ifayela lezilungiselelo ngesandla.

Enkinobheni ethi “Landa amalogi” yohlelo oluxhuma ngewebhu, usungathola ifayela eliphelele lezilinganiso noma nini iseshini isaqhubeka. Isiphequluli besiligcina liphelele kuphela lapho ukusakaza kuphela. Uma ubulilanda phakathi neseshini, ubuthola ifayela elishodayo, bese kudingeka unqamule ukuxhumana ukuze uthole yonke idatha yakho. Manje izilinganiso zibhalwa ngamaqoqo, hhayi ngasinye ngasinye. Noma iseshini ikhiqiza izinkulungwane zamasampula ngomzuzwana, awasalahleki.

Uma ukhetha ukuthumela ividiyo nge-gopstream, i-Kyber izivala yona indlela yokuvuselela uhlaka ngezingxenye. Lezi zindlela azikwazi ukusebenza ndawonye: ukuvuselela uhlaka ngezingxenye kususa izinhlaka eziyisihluthulelo ezifika ngezikhawu, okuyizo i-gopstream ezisebenzisayo ukuhlukanisa izingxenye zevidiyo. Phambilini, ukuzisebenzisa zombili bekubuyisela ukudlulisa endleleni evamile eqinisekisa ukufika kwedatha, kungaveli sixwayiso, kodwa i-gopstream iqhubeke idla izinsiza. Ngenxa yalolu shintsho nokulungiswa kwemininingwane esekuqaleni kwedatha kule nguqulo, i-gopstream isisebenza okokuqala ngendlela ehloswe ngayo.

Amalogi asenendawo entsha

Noma ungakufundi okunye, kufunde lokhu.

Ingxenye ngayinye ye-Kyber ibigcina ilogi yayo eduze kwefayela layo lohlelo. Manje amalogi agcinwa lapho isistimu yokusebenza ngayinye ilindele ukuwathola khona:

  • Amasevisi e-Windows: %ProgramData%\Kyber\logs
  • Uhlelo lwekhompuyutha oluxhumayo ku-Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Kyber\logs
  • macOS: ~/Library/Logs/Kyber, ukuze i-Console.app iwathole
  • Linux: ~/.local/state/kyber/logs

Uma umhlahlandlela wakho wokusekela, iskripthi sokuqoqa amalogi noma umthetho wokuqapha usakhomba endaweni endala, ngeke kusatholakala lutho lapho, futhi ngeke kube nasexwayiso. Usengasebenzisa u-KYBER_LOG_DIR ukukhetha enye indawo esikhundleni salezi.

Okuhle ukuthi ekugcineni usungakhetha ukuthi amalogi abhale imininingwane engakanani ngaphandle kokuhlanganisa ikhodi kabusha. Ungasebenzisa inketho yomyalo ethi --log-level, inani lesistimu elithi KYBER_LOG_LEVEL, noma okhiye abathi log_level ku-kyber_config.toml. Ungakhetha izinga lengxenye ngayinye: uma ingxenye ethile ikuhlupha, ungayenza ibhale nomniningwane omncane kunayo yonke, ungagcwalisi amalogi ngemininingwane yezinye izingxenye. U-KYBER_VLC_VERBOSE naye usesebenza ngendlela efanele: phambilini ubevulela i-VLC indlela yokubhala amalogi, kodwa engayitsheli ukuthi ibhale.

Kunye okungashintshile: amafayela amalogi asakhula angenamkhawulo. Le nguqulo ayikawashintshi ngokuzenzakalela lapho esekhule kakhulu.

Uhlelo selusebenza ngokuthembeka kakhudlwana

kyclient: Kulungiswe izinkinga eziningana ebeziphazamisa uhlelo lwekhompuyutha oluxhumayo. Alusaphahlazeki uma indawo olusebenza kuyo idedelwa ngesikhathi esingafanele, futhi aluvali uma iseva ibika inani elingaphandle kwemingcele evumelekile. Alusayilahli imicimbi ebalulekile, njengomcimbi wokuthi sekuxhunyiwe, lapho ulayini wangaphakathi ugcwala. Nomsebenzi wokuqoqa izilinganiso awusasali usebenza ngemva kokunqamula ukuxhumana, ulokhu ukhipha izibalo ezindala njalo ngemizuzwana emihlanu.

kymedia: Emishinini esingatha ukuxhumana esebenzisa i-Wayland, ubukhulu nendawo yesibonisi sekutholwa ngokuqondile kunokuba kuqagelwe. Ku-Windows, isiteshi esihlukile esithwala imininingwane yesikhombi segundane esikude siyaphinda sizame ukuxhuma uma umzamo wokuqala ungaphumeleli. Phambilini, ukungahambisani kwesikhathi sokuqalisa bekungakushiya iseshini yonke ungakwazi ukusebenzisa isikhombi esilawulwa yikhadi lezithombe. Lapho kuthwetshulwa nge-DRM/KMS ku-Linux, ikhadi lezithombe elehluleka ukuqalisa selibikwa kanye kuphela ngedivayisi, hhayi njalo lapho lihlolwa. Ngaleyo ndlela, imishini enama-GPU amaningi ayisagcwalisi amalogi ngomugqa ofanayo izinkulungwane zezikhathi.

kymux: Ukuthumela nokwamukela engxenyeni yokudlulisa idatha sekungakhanselwa ngokuphepha. Uma ukuxhumana kunqamuka kusabhalwa, akusasali iphakethe elibhalwe ingxenye kuphela. Umlayezo ongabonwa uhlelo awusakunqamuli ukuxhumana. Uma ividiyo noma umsindo ufika uhlukaniswe waba amaphakethe e-UDP amaningana, uhlelo selwabela inkumbulo kanye, ngesilinganiso esifanele, esikhundleni sokulokhu landisa indawo yokugcina idatha lapho luyihlanganisa kabusha.

kynput: Uma i-C API inikwa isikhombi esingakhombi lutho, ayenzi lutho, kunokuba umphumela ungachazeki. Lokhu kuvala izindlela ezimbili ebezingaphahlaza uhlelo.

Okufanele bakwazi abahlanganisi bezinhlelo nabaphathi bamasistimu

Kunezinguquko ezimbili okudingeka uzilungiselele uma zikuthinta.

Uma uhlanganisa i-Kyber nohlelo lwakho nge-C API yayo, le nguqulo ayisahambisani nekhodi ekhona ngaphandle kokuyilungisa. Amagama ezinhlobo zedatha manje akhiwa ngesiqalo esingaguquguquki, ngakho ambalwa awo ashintshile:

  • Position → kynput_Position
  • Size → kynput_Size
  • UnicodeInput → kynput_UnicodeInput
  • VideoLayout → kynput_VideoLayout
  • kyclient_metrics_cb → kyclient_MetricsCb
  • kyclient_metrics_json_producer → kyclient_MetricsJsonProducer
  • kyclient_metrics_json → kyclient_MetricsJson

Umsebenzi othi kyclient_event_get_type nawo usuthatha ireferensi. Akukho okunye okushintshile emafayeleni ezimemezelo ze-C, ngakho okusele ukumane ushintshe amagama.

Emshinini we-Linux osingatha ukuxhumana, uma isigaba esithi [kyavserver] singenawo umugqa othi grab_backend, i-0.28 ikhetha i-nvfbc, kanti i-0.27 ibingabeki nketho emisiwe. Uma umshini wakho ungasebenzisi ikhadi le-NVIDIA, yisho ngokucacile ukuthi usebenzise yiphi: drm, xcb noma wlroots. Igama lesilungiselelo lona alishintshile.

Amagama amafayela alandwayo e-macOS nawo ashintshile. Manje kunefayela leseva elilandwa lodwa, ngaphezu kwelohlelo oluxhumayo. Uma izikripthi zakho zisebenzisa amagama amadala, zihlole.

Thola inguqulo entsha

I-Kyber 0.28 isiyatholakala.

Vakashela ikhasi lokulanda ukuze uthole inguqulo yakamuva, noma ulande amaphakheji abuyekeziwe ngendlela ojwayele ukuyisebenzisa.

Siyamukela imibono nemibiko yamaphutha ku-Discord yethu.
